<sense>

<italic>will, desire; willingness</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Y. Lev. VIII, 15 (ed. Vien. צְבֹו). Targ. Y. Gen. XXIV, 5. Targ. Job XXXI, 16 ed. Lag. (oth. ed. צַבְאוּת); a. e.—Yoma 86

<sup>a</sup> (line 20) מים מגולין שתה ונ' (ed. Krot. שתת ונצבית, corr. acc.) he drank uncovered water (poisoned by a serpent) and his belly was swollen. Ib. (line 25) שתת ונִצְבֵּית she drank &c.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>

<entry id="R00034">
<head-word>צְבֵי</head-word>
<head-word>צְבָא</head-word>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (cmp. צבת) [
<italic>to seize; to bend</italic>; cmp. חָפַץ,] with ב, 
<italic>to find pleasure in, to choose, desire</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Y. Gen. XXXIV, 19 (h. text חפץ). Targ. Prov. III, 31 (h. text בחר). Targ. O. Ex. II, 21 (h. text יאל). Targ. Y. Deut. XXIII, 6 (h. text אבה); a. fr.—[Targ. Prov. II, 4 תצביה, ed. Wil., v. בְּצָא.]—Part. צָכֵי; f. צַבְיָא; 
<plural-form>pl. צָבִין; צַבְיָין</plural-form>. Targ. Prov. XI, 20. Targ. II Esth. I, 16. Targ. Prov. XXI, 25 (ed. Lag. עפיין, v. עֲפֵי); a. e.—Tosef. Yeb. XIII, 1 לית היא צביא וכ' she refuses to be married to him. Snh. 65
<sup>b</sup> דמרי צ' the master has found pleasure (in that man); שבת נמי מרי צ' the Sabbath likewise (is distinguished, because) the Lord has chosen it. Y. Keth. VII, 31
<sup>c</sup> ולא תִצְבֵּי, v. פּוּתְיָא; a. e.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="R00035">
<head-word>צְבִי</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<language-reference>
<xref rid="A00083"> preced.; cmp. חֵפֶץ)</xref></language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>desirable thing, beauty</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Tanḥ. Mishp. 17 (ref. to Jer. III, 19) נחלת צבי … ארץ שנתאוו וכ' ‘an inheritance of choice’ …, a land which the kings of the world coveted. Num. R. s. 23 (ref. to Ez. XX, 6, a. Jer. l. c.) חביבה עלי ארץ וכ' the land of Israel is more precious to me than &c.—
<plural-form>Pl. צְבִיּוֹת</plural-form>. Yalk. Cant. 988 צְבִיּוֹתֵיהֶן, v. infra.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>deer, gazelle</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Keth. 112
<sup>a</sup> (ref. to Jer. l. c.) א"י נמשלה לצ' מה צ' וכ' the land of Israel is compared to a deer, as the skin of a deer (when once taken off) cannot again cover its body, so cannot Palestine contain its fruits; Gitt. 57
<sup>a</sup>, v. חָזַק; Tanḥ. l. c.; a. e.—Tosef. Sabb. VII (VIII), 13 פסק צ' את הדרך וכ' a deer cut the way off before me (a superstitious omen); Snh. 65
<sup>b</sup> צ' הפסיקו בדרך a deer cut him (me) off &c.—Y. Gitt. II, 44
<sup>b</sup> bot.; Tosef. ib. II, 4 כתבו על קרן של צ' וכ' if he wrote a letter of divorce on the horn of a deer, and cut it off and gave it to her. Keth XIII, 2 הניח מעותיו על קרן הצ' he has put his money on a deer’s horn, i.e. he cannot reclaim the unauthorized expense; a. fr.—
<plural-form>Pl. צְבָאִים, צְבָאִין, צְבָיִים</plural-form>. Sabb. 128
<sup>a</sup>; Tosef. ib. XIV (XV), 8; Y. ib. XVIII, 16
<sup>c</sup>, v. חֲצָב II. Gen. R. s. 31; a. fr.—Fem. צְבִיָּה, צְבִיָּיה. Ḥull. 79
<sup>b</sup>, sq. Yalk. Cant. 988 למה … כצ' שרבתה צביותיהן וכ' why is Jochebed likened to a hind? Because she reared the beauties of Israel (Moses and Aaron); a. e.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<number>1)</number>
<definition />

<definition> (צָבַע I) 
<italic>handling</italic>; בית הצ' that part of a vessel by which it is handled, v. 
<xref rid="R00041">צְבִיטָה</xref>.</definition>
<notes> Kel. XXV, 7 כל הכלים … ובית הצ' all vessels have backs, insides and handling places (independent of one another, v. צְבִיטָה); ib. 8 כיצד … אחזו בבית צְבִיעָתוֹ וכ' how is this? If one’s hands are clean, and the back of a cup is unclean, and he seizes it by its handling place. Ib. נטילתו באחת צביעתו באחת that which is taken up with one hand (at one special place) has one handling place (for the purposes of levitical cleanness); מקום אחיזתו שם צביעתו at whatever place a vessel is taken hold of, there is its handle. Y. Ḥag. III, 78

<entry id="R00118">
<head-word>צָדַק</head-word>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<language-reference>
<xref rid="unknown"> reduplic. of זק; cmp. זָכָה)</xref></language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> [
<italic>to be clear, pure, sincere</italic>,] 
<italic>to be right, true, just; to be cleared</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Snh. IV, 22
<sup>b</sup> top יכול אם צ' בדינך יִצְדַּק בדיני you may think, if he (the guilty) is cleared in thy court, he will also be cleared in my (God’s) court.</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pi.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>צִדֵּק</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition> (cmp. (cmp. זכה) 
<italic>to act in favor of a person; to be liberal</italic>.</definition>
<notes> B. Bath. 88
<sup>b</sup> (ref. to Deut. XXV, 15) צַדֵּק משלך ותן לו be liberal with what is thine own and give it to him, i.e. add overweight and overmeasure (גֵּירוּמִים); Ḥull. 134
<sup>a</sup> (ref. to the poor man’s share). Num. R. s. 2 (ref. to ואתן צדק Job XXVI, 3) צי' עמהם שלא וכ' the Lord dealt kindly with them in not changing their arrangements.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to justify, declare or consider a person right; to defend</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Gen. R. s. 49 (ref. to Ps. XLV, 8) אהבת לצַדֵּק את בריותי וכ' thou (Abraham) lovest to defend my creatures, and hatest to condemn them. Y. Snh. IV, beg. 22
<sup>a</sup> צַדְּקֵיהוּ consider him to be right (a true witness), opp. חקריהו cross-examine him; Deut. R. s. 5.—Esp. צ' את הדין 
<italic>to justify God’s judgment, to submit to divine dispensation as just, to punishment as deserved</italic>. Sifra Sh’mini, introd. כיון ששמע אהרן כך צ' … ושתק when Aaron heard this, he submitted to divine judgment and kept his peace (Lev. X, 3). Ib. אברהם צי' עליו וכ' Abraham resigned himself to God’s will, for we read (Gen. XVIII, 27), ‘I am dust and ashes’. Ib. צִידְּקוּ עליהם וכ' they resigned themselves &c. Y. Sot. VIII, 22
<sup>c</sup> bot. צ̇ד̇ק̇יהו שצ̇יר̇ק̇ עליו וכ'. Shallum was surnamed Zedekiah (justifier of God), because he justified God’s judgment upon him. Ab. Zar. 18
<sup>a</sup> בשעה שיצאו … צידקו עליהם וכ' all three of them, when they were taken out for execution, resigned themselves &c. (reciting an appropriate Bible verse); a. fr.—Part. pass. מְצוּדָּק; 
<plural-form>pl. מְצוּדָּקִים</plural-form>. Mekh. Mishp., s. 20 (ref. to Ex. XXIII, 8) שונא דברים המצ' וכ' he will hate the justified words (the exhortations to justice) spoken at Sinai; Yalk. Ex. 353 (not דברי).</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הִצְדִּיק</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to justify, clear, declare to be right; to make virtuous</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Snh. 10
<sup>a</sup> (ref. to Deut. XXV, 1) עדים שהרשיעו את הצדיק ואתו … והִצְדִּיקוּ וכ' when witnesses denounced an innocent man, and other witnesses came and justified him that was right, and thus exposed those (first witnesses) as wicked men; Macc. 2
<sup>b</sup>. Gen. R. s. 21 (ref. to Ps. XVI, 5) לכשיקיץ … אני מַצְדִּיקוֹ מאותה גזרה when he that is created in thine (Adam’s) image shall awake (when the Messiah comes) …, then I shall clear him from this decree (of expulsion from Eden). Lev. R. s. 4, beg. (ref. to Koh. III, 16) מקום שהִצְדַּקְתִּים וכ' there where I made them virtuous and called them divine beings …, there they acted wickedly &c. Gen. R. s. 43 (ref. to Gen. XIV, 18) המקום הזה מַצְדִּיק וכ' this place (Salem-Jerusalem) makes its inhabitants righteous.—ה' עליו את הדין 
<italic>to deal strictly with</italic>. Taan. 8
<sup>a</sup> כל המצדיק … מַצְדִּיקִין עליו את הדין וכ' he who makes himself righteous here below (who strives for righteousness) is judged righteously (strictly dealt with) in the judgment above (cmp. Yeb. 121
<sup>b</sup> quot. s. v. דִּקְדֵּק). Hor. 11
<sup>b</sup> (play on צדקיהו) אמר לו יה יַצְדִּיק עליך וכ' he (Nebuchadnezzar) said to him, Yah shall deal strictly with thee, if thou wilt rebel against me; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to treat with</italic> צְדָקָה, 
<italic>to be liberal towards</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Peah IV, end 18
<sup>c</sup> (alluding to Ps. LXXXII, </notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>3)</number>
<definition> עני ורש הַצְדִּיקוּהוּ במתנותיו (not ועשיר) treat the poor and needy liberally as regards the gifts belonging to him (v. Ḥull. 134
<sup>a</sup> quot.</definition>
<notes> supra).—3) ה' את הדין 
<italic>to submit to divine judgment, be resigned</italic> (v. supra). Sifra l. c. למודים צדיקים שמַצְדִּיקִים וכ' the righteous are wont to resign themselves to the will of God. Taan. 11
<sup>a</sup> מצדיק עליו וכ' he acknowledges the justice of the verdict and says, you have judged me rightly &c. Ber. 19
<sup>a</sup> והוא עומד ומצדיק וכ' he (the mourner) stands up and declares the judgment to be just &c.; a. fr.—
<italic>Part. pass.</italic> מוּצְדָּק 
<italic>justified, lawfully qualified</italic>. Gitt. 86
<sup>a</sup> (in a Chaldaic formula of sale of a slave) מ' לעבדו, v. עַבְדּוּתָא.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hithpa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הִצְטַדֵּק</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to justify one’s self, excuse one’s self</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Gen. R. s. 92 (ref. to Gen. XLIV, 16) מה נִצְטַּדָּק בדינה how can we justify ourselves for what we have done in the case of Dinah (that we killed the Shechemites)? &c.; Yalk. ib. 150.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<pgbrk id="pg1264" />(or charity) and justice atone for &c. Pes. 87

<notes> Sifré Deut. 205 (ref. to Deut. XXI, 1 בשדה) ולא צָף על וכ' but not when found floating on the water; Sot. IX, 2. Y. Peah VI, 19
<sup>c</sup> (if two bodies are found, one lying on top of the other, the ceremony of breaking a heifer’s neck is not performed) התחתון משום … משום צף not for the lower one, because it is hidden, nor for the upper one, because it lies in a conspicuous place; Sot. 45
<sup>a</sup> (referring to two sheaves lying one upon the other) והעליון מפני שהוא צף (Ar. עף) and the upper is not considered a forgotten sheaf, because &c. Ib. צָפוּ עומרין לתוך וכ' (Ar. עפו) if sheaves floated into a neighbor’s field; ib. צפו אין מונחין לא only when they came to lie in a conspicuous place, and not when they rested on the ground? Ib. bot. מין במינו לא הוי צף one thing lying on another of the same kind is not considered as above the ground. Cant. R. to VII, 9 צף הכבשן the furnace (in the ground) came 
<pgbrk id="pg1269" />up to the surface (v. פְּלַטְיָא II). Ab. II, 6 גולגולת שצָפָה וכ' a skull floating on the water. Makhsh. IV, 5 הנתזין והצָפִין water that is squirted out of, and that which overflows the vessel; Sabb. 12
<sup>a</sup> והצפין Rashi, a. Ms. O. (ed. והנצפין, corr. acc.); a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>

<notes> Sot. 48
<sup>b</sup>; Y. ib. IX, 24
<sup>b</sup> bot., v. נוֹפֶת; Tanḥ. Ekeb 1 fine flour שהיא צפה בנפה (not בפה) which sticks to the sieve; Yalk. Ps. 676 שהוא נפה בנפה (corr. acc.).—V. צָף.</notes></sense></senses>

II, 7 (expl. מימי אדמה) מבקעת בית כרם ומֵצִיף (עליה) מים earth from the valley of Beth Kerem, upon which you make water float; Y. ed. מֵיצֵף עליו מים (fr. צָפַף); expl. ib. 50
